description:
This is a temporary position.

 The assignment duration is through April 28, 2028.

 JOB SUMMARY 

 The Full Stack Engineer builds and supports the technology platform used to manage Marriott’s job architecture work. This role creates tools and system features that help teams organize job content, manage the job catalog, review incumbent mapping, track data quality, and support program reporting. The position partners with job architecture, HR, compensation, HR technology, and engineering stakeholders to build a solution aligned with enterprise standards that can be supported after implementation. [PI1]  

  

 CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 Education and Experience 

 Required  

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or high school diploma/GED and 4+ years of professional experience

 6+ years’ experience building business-facing applications, reports, dashboards, or workflow tools.

 6+ years’ experience working with data, system integrations, user requirements, or technology solutions in an HR or enterprise business environment. [PI2]  

 Python programming experience preferably with FastAPI, Django, or Flask.

 SQL experience including writing complex queries and working with relational data models.

 
 Preferred 

 
 Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud, Oracle tools, or other enterprise HR technology platforms.

 Experience supporting job architecture, workforce data, HR transformation, or other complex business process initiatives. [MT3]  

 Experience creating clear documentation, testing materials, support guides, or handoff materials for ongoing system support. [PI4]  

 
  

 CORE WORK ACTIVITIES 

 
 Builds and supports technology tools used to manage job architecture work.

 Creates user-friendly screens, workflows, reports, and dashboards for job architecture, HR, compensation, and business users.

 Owns the integration of job catalog data with Oracle HCM Cloud and related HR systems.

 Develops tools that support job catalog management, work activity libraries, incumbent review, data validation, and program tracking.

 Partners with HR technology and integration teams to define data needs, system requirements, and implementation steps.

 Supports data design, reporting, and system logic needed to keep job architecture information accurate and usable.

 Converts business requirements into working application features, workflow logic, reports, dashboards, and system enhancements.

 Creates testing, documentation, and support materials so the tools can be maintained after implementation.

 Supports issue resolution, production readiness, and handoff to the team that will maintain the tools going forward.

 
  

 
 
 
  

 

 



 At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.  



 
 All locations offer 401(k) plan, stock purchase plan, discounts at Marriott properties, commuter benefits, employee assistance plan, and childcare discounts.  Benefits are subject to terms and conditions, which may include rules regarding eligibility, enrollment, waiting period, contribution, benefit limits, election changes, benefit exclusions, and others. Click here  to learn more.


 
 



 
 Full-time positions also offer coverage for medical, dental, vision, health care flexible spending account, dependent care flexible spending account, life insurance, disability insurance, accident insurance, adoption expense reimbursements, and paid parental leave.


 
 



 
 Washington Applicants Only : Employees will accrue paid sick leave, 0.0384 PTO balance for every hour worked and be eligible to receive minimum of 9 holidays annually.


 
 



 
 Marriott Headquarters (HQ) supports a hybrid work environment that helps associates Be Connected. HQ based roles are generally hybrid and require regular in-office presence at the assigned location, including for candidates who live within commuting distance of HQ for a role listed as remote. Remote roles will be clearly identified in the job posting.
